title: So Much Slime
author: Jason Lefebvre
intro: Matty and his family love making stretchy, squishy slime at home. Now Matty wants to show his art class how to make it too!
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.q: What does Matty's family love to make at home?
questions.clue: It is stretchy, scientific, and super squishy.
questions.yes: Matty and his family love to make slime.

questions.q: Where does Matty do his slime demonstration?

options.text: In his art class at school

questions.clue: His art teacher gives him permission to show his classmates.
questions.yes: Matty does his slime demonstration in art class at school.

questions.q: What are the three main ingredients needed to make Matty's slime?

options.text: Soap, sugar, and warm milk from home

questions.clue: Mum reminds him that he needs glue, baking soda, and one more liquid.
questions.yes: The three ingredients are glue, baking soda, and saline.

questions.q: Why does Matty pour six bottles of glue into the bowl?

options.text: He wants enough slime for everyone

questions.clue: He wants his whole class to have some slime.
questions.yes: Matty uses six bottles so there is enough slime for everyone.

questions.q: What does Matty squeeze into the bowl while Julia stirs?
questions.clue: It changes the colour of the mixture while Julia stirs.
questions.yes: Matty squeezes in food colouring while Julia stirs.

questions.q: Why does Matty's mixture spread into an icky, sticky swamp?

options.text: He forgot to bring the saline
He forgot to bring the baking soda

questions.clue: He left the third magic ingredient at home.
questions.yes: The mixture spreads into a swamp because Matty forgot the saline.

questions.q: How does Matty feel when he gets stuck in the sticky swamp?
questions.clue: He groans and wails because his demonstration is a disaster.
questions.yes: Matty feels upset when his slime demonstration turns into a swamp.

questions.q: What do Izzy, Julia, and Noah throw onto the table first?
questions.clue: Izzy says these small fuzzy craft balls look like little mops.
questions.yes: They throw fuzzy pompoms onto the table first.

questions.q: What happens when Luke and the others dump sand into the swamp?

options.text: It makes a wave that Matty surfs

questions.clue: The sand goes swoosh and moves like ocean water.
questions.yes: The sand makes a big wave and Matty surfs in the swamp.

questions.q: What do Owen and Noah use because they look like tiny towels?
questions.clue: They have the shapes of the alphabet, like A and B.
questions.yes: Owen and Noah fling felt letters into the swamp.

questions.q: What happens when the classmates try to whip the swamp into slime?

options.text: A giant bubble grows and explodes

questions.clue: Mixing it makes bubbles rise until the biggest one goes kaboom.
questions.yes: Whipping the swamp makes bubbles until the biggest bubble explodes.

questions.q: Who comes into the classroom and tosses prizes into the swamp?
questions.clue: She checks if everyone is okay, and she is all out of saline.
questions.yes: The school nurse bursts in and adds prizes for pizzazz.

questions.q: Where does Owen find the saline that saves the slime?
questions.clue: He runs to the room where the science teacher works.
questions.yes: Owen brings back saline from the school science lab.

questions.q: How do Matty and his classmates clean up the classroom so quickly?

options.text: They roll the slime blobs around
They wash the floor with soapy water

questions.clue: The big sticky blobs pick up all the extra bits.
questions.yes: They roll the big blobs of slime around to pick up the mess.

questions.q: How does everyone feel when the swamp turns into squishy slime?
questions.clue: The classmates gasp and Dad lifts Matty into the air.
questions.yes: Everyone feels amazed when the swamp turns into spectacular squishy slime.
